title: Additivity of expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then $\mathbb E_p(f+g)=\mathbb E_p f+\mathbb E_p g$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
